description:
Port pi-mono's compaction logic as a new pure module.

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/compaction/compaction.ts

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/compaction.ex.

## find_cut_point/2

Signature: (SessionManager.t(), keep_recent_tokens :: non_neg_integer()) -> String.t() | nil

Returns the entry id of the OLDEST entry that will be kept (not summarized),
or nil if the full session fits within keep_recent_tokens.

Algorithm (port from pi-mono lines 386-448):
  1. Get the branch via SessionManager.get_branch/1 (oldest-first).
  2. Walk BACKWARD from the newest entry, accumulating a token estimate.
  3. Stop when accumulated tokens exceed keep_recent_tokens.
  4. The entry at the stopping point is a candidate cut point.
  5. Valid cut points: MessageEntry wrapping a User or Assistant message,
     or CustomMessageEntry.
     NEVER cut at a MessageEntry wrapping a ToolResult — that would split
     a tool-use turn. Walk backward past it to the preceding Assistant message.
  6. Token estimate per entry: byte_size(Jason.encode!(entry.message)) is a
     good-enough proxy for a first pass (no tokenizer needed yet).

## prepare/2

Signature: (SessionManager.t(), keep_recent_tokens :: non_neg_integer()) ->
  %{
    messages_to_summarize: [SessionEntry.t()],
    first_kept_entry_id: String.t(),
    tokens_before: non_neg_integer()
  }

Calls find_cut_point/2 to split the branch. Returns the entries that will be
discarded (everything before first_kept_entry_id) and the id of the first kept entry.
tokens_before is the total estimated token count of the FULL branch before compaction.

## compact/3

Signature: (SessionManager.t(), transport :: module(), model :: OctoPi.AI.Model.t(),
             opts \\ []) ->
  {:ok, %{summary: String.t(), first_kept_entry_id: String.t(), tokens_before: integer()}}
  | {:error, reason}

Steps:
  1. Call prepare/2 (default keep_recent_tokens: 8000 or configurable via opts).
  2. Build a summarization prompt:
     system: "You are summarizing a conversation to compress it. Produce a concise
              but complete summary of everything that was discussed, decided, and
              done. The summary will replace the earlier messages."
     messages: convert messages_to_summarize entries to a plain-text transcript
               (each entry formatted as "Role: content\n")
  3. Call transport.stream(model, context, %OctoPi.AI.StreamOptions{}) and collect
     the full text response.
  4. Return {:ok, %{summary: text, first_kept_entry_id: ..., tokens_before: ...}}.

DO NOT append to session_manager — that is the caller's responsibility.

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/compaction_test.exs.
Use a stub transport (implement OctoPi.Agent.Transport behaviour) that returns
a fixed summary string for any request.
Cover:
  - find_cut_point/2 respects keep_recent_tokens budget
  - find_cut_point/2 never cuts at a ToolResult (walks back to preceding Assistant)
  - compact/3 returns the summary from the transport
  - compact/3 does NOT mutate the session_manager
Port relevant tests from tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/ if they exist.
title: Implement OctoPi.Agent.Compaction module
